title: Red Hat Security Advisory: xdg-desktop-portal security update
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-55888) exists in the xdg-desktop-portal package used by Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10.0 Extended Update Support. The flaw allows unauthorized host file access via unvalidated FileChooser filenames in the portal interfaces exposed over D-Bus. This could potentially allow unauthorized access to files on the host system. Red Hat has released an update to address this issue.
